importExport.title: Export and import
importExport.hint: Import appends purchases, deposits, and reconciliations to the current card chronologically. Included card settings replace current settings before import.

settings.installmentInfo: Installment cards have no grace period: terms are set for each purchase.

settingsForm.reportDayHelp: Day of the month when the statement period closes

modelInfo.sber_120: Sber: fixed statement-based model. Purchases follow the report day cycle and grace lasts 4 statement periods.
modelInfo.ozon_78: Ozon: grace starts from the first purchase after the balance is fully repaid. The purchase window lasts up to 2 calendar months, then there are 16 days to repay the debt.
modelInfo.custom_statement: Custom statement-based model: use a fixed report day, statement period count, and payment window after the final statement closes.
modelInfo.legacy_months: Legacy model: debt is rolled over by calendar months until the configured due day. Keep this only for old card settings.

settingsForm.gracePeriodsHelp: Legacy mode: spread debt across calendar months until due date
settingsForm.graceDueDayHelp: Legacy mode: day of month when the bucket must be closed
settingsForm.graceStatementPeriodsHelp: How many statement periods are covered by grace, including the current one
settingsForm.paymentDueOffsetDaysHelp: How many calendar days after the final statement close the payment is due
settingsForm.ozonAnchorPreviewValue: Set automatically from the first purchase after full repayment
settingsForm.ozonAnchorPreviewHelp: This date is assigned automatically when new debt appears after the balance returns to zero
settingsForm.ozonExample: Ozon example: first purchase on May 12 -> purchase window until July 11 -> repay the debt by July 27.

accounts.ratesStale: CBR is unavailable, the last known rates are used.

interestModeHelp.daily: A day's interest is added to the account the next day.
interestModeHelp.monthly: Interest accrues on the daily balance and is added to the account on the payout day.
interestModeHelp.maturity: Interest accrues on the daily balance and is paid on the maturity date.

form.name: Name
form.isLiquidHelp: Money you can spend right away. Deposits and brokerage accounts usually are not.
form.validation: Check the name, the currency (three letters, e.g. USD) and the amount.

page.balanceHint: Enter the balance your bank shows. Entering it again for the same date replaces the record.
page.archiveHint: Archive a closed account instead of deleting it: it stays in the net worth history until the archive date.
page.deleteText: The account and all its balances ({{count}}) will be deleted; the net worth history will change.

savings.disabled: Interest is not calculated for this account. To turn it on, choose how interest is paid in the account settings below.
savings.title: Interest
savings.noRate: No rate entered, so no interest accrues. Add a "New rate" operation.
savings.daysWithoutRate_one: {{count}} day with money on the account but no rate: no interest was accrued for it.
savings.daysWithoutRate_other: {{count}} days with money on the account but no rate: no interest was accrued for them.
savings.forecastHint: At the current rate, including future operations already entered.
savings.eventsHint: Top-ups, withdrawals and rate changes. The balance and interest are recalculated from them.
savings.eventValidation: Enter a date and an amount above zero or a rate from 0 to 100.
savings.bankBalanceHint: Now and then enter the balance your bank shows: it is compared with the calculation, which then continues from it.

interestTax.hint: Estimate for rouble savings accounts and deposits with interest calculation: 13% of income above the tax-free amount (15% above 2.4 mln ₽). The tax office charges it next year, the bank does not withhold it.
interestTax.keyRateStale: CBR is unreachable right now, the key rate may be incomplete.
interestTax.excluded: Foreign currency accounts ({{currencies}}) are not included.

tinvest.title: T-Bank Invest
tinvest.intro: Values of T-Bank brokerage accounts can update automatically. A read-only token is needed.
tinvest.tokenHelp: The token is stored encrypted and used only to read the portfolio.
tinvest.notSynced: Not updated yet — add accounts below.
tinvest.syncHint: Portfolio values update automatically every 6 hours. Disconnecting deletes the token; the accounts stay with their history.
tinvest.invalidToken: T-Bank rejected the token: check that it is copied in full and not revoked.
tinvest.undecryptable: The stored token cannot be decrypted (JWT_SECRET changed?). Enter the token again.

financePlan.monthsHint: "Expenses" leave the accounts on their date. "On cards" are planned card purchases: they leave the accounts later, within "Debt payments", together with the current card, installment and mortgage debts. "To savings" are transfers to deposits; transfers to free savings accounts do not reduce free money.
financePlan.factSubtitle: What was left after income and spending: planned and from the balances you entered

fact.estimated: No free account balances were entered this month, so the actual figure may be off.

financePlan.factHint: Actual = change in free money + card and mortgage repayments − card purchases. The more often you enter balances, the more accurate it is.

form.name: Name
form.spreadHelp: The amount is spent a little every day until the next repetition rather than at once — e.g. living expenses.
form.cardHelp: This money leaves the accounts when the purchases are due under the card grace rules. For installment cards — on the purchase day.
form.validation: Check the name, an amount above zero and the dates.
